title: thurward rules.yaml
description: The IaC contract for thurward (ADR 0011). Anything that can render YAML satisfying this schema can configure a thurward unikernel build. Compiled into the image at build time (ADR 0005); there is no runtime admin API (ADR 0009).

rules.description: Filter rules, matched top-to-bottom. First match wins; if none match, defaults.default_action applies.

defaults.description: Global defaults. Every field is optional; omitted fields use the documented thurward defaults.

default_action.description: Action when no rule matches. Production deployments should keep this as 'deny' (zero-trust).

upstream_dns.description: Recursive resolver the DNS proxy forwards client queries to.

flow_trace_sample_accept.description: Sampling rate for OTel spans on accepted flows (0.0 = none, 1.0 = all).

flow_trace_sample_drop.description: Sampling rate for OTel spans on dropped flows.

dns_qps_per_client.description: Per-source-IP QPS limit on the DNS proxy. Excess queries get SERVFAIL.

conntrack_timeouts.description: Conntrack idle/expiry timeouts in seconds (ADR 0014). Tunable; documented defaults applied when omitted.

nat.description: SNAT/masquerade + static DNAT (ADR 0014). Filter rules always reference real internal IPs; the filter sees pre-SNAT / post-DNAT tuples.

snat_entry.description: Source NAT: rewrite the source address of egress traffic matching `source` going out `out_interface`.

source.description: LAN-side CIDR whose egress should be SNAT'd.

masquerade.description: If true, rewrite to the egress interface's primary IP. Mutually exclusive with external_ip.

external_ip.description: Specific external IP to rewrite to. Mutually exclusive with masquerade.

port_range.description: Override the default SNAT port pool (16384-60999).

dnat_entry.description: Static destination NAT (port-forward). Rewrites wan_ip:wan_port to `to` for inbound packets matching `proto` (and optionally `from`).

rule.description: A single filter rule. `id` and `action` are required; everything else narrows what the rule matches.

id.description: Stable identifier used in metrics labels and log fields. Should be unique across the file.

name.description: Human-readable description; appears in ECS rule.name.

direction.description: Determined by which NIC the packet entered on. Omit to match either direction.

source.description: Source CIDR. Omit to match any source.

destination.description: Destination CIDR or IP. Mutually exclusive with destination_fqdn.

destination_fqdn.description: Destination FQDNs. Supports exact names and one-level wildcard ('*.example.com'). No regex. Matches when fqdn_set currently binds dst_ip to one of these names. Mutually exclusive with destination.

state.description: Match flows already tracked by conntrack. 'established' fires for return traffic on existing flows (ADR 0014).

cidr4.description: IPv4 CIDR (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24). Host bits should be zero.

fqdn_or_wildcard.description: FQDN or one-level wildcard '*.domain.tld'. ASCII only; punycode IDNs.
